title: rubus moluccanus var. sieboldii
intro: Rubus moluccanus var. sieboldii, commonly known as Siebold's Molucca raspberry, is a species of raspberry native to East Asia. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, which include reducing inflammation and improving cardiovascular health. The therapeutic actions of Rubus moluccanus var. sieboldii include antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antibacterial effects, which may help alleviate various health issues. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and tannins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
